arxiv-2107-07667.title: Nonequilibrium thermal transport and photon squeezing in a quadratic qubit-resonator system
arxiv-2107-07667.creator: Chen Wang 1,, Hua Chen 1, Jie-Qiao Liao 2,
arxiv-2107-07667.description: Abstract We investigate steady-state thermal transport and photon statistics in a nonequilibrium hybrid quantum system, in which a qubit is longitudinally and quadratically coupled to an optical resonator. Our calculations are conducted with the method of the quantum dressed master equation combined with full counting statistics.

arxiv-2210-06252.title: Physical Significance of Noether Symmetries
arxiv-2210-06252.creator: Asghar Qadir, Ugur Camci
arxiv-2210-06252.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Asghar Qadir, Ugur Camci. In this paper we will trace the development of the use of symmetry in discussing the theory of motion initiated by Emmy Noether in 1918. Though it started with its use in Classical Mechanics, and has been heavily used in engineering applications of Mechanics, it came into its own in Relativity, and Quantum Theory and their applications in Particle Physics and Field Theory.

arxiv-2303-09010.title: Non-perturbative Many-Body Treatment of Molecular Magnets
arxiv-2303-09010.creator: Brandon Eskridge, Henry Krakauer, Shiwei Zhang
arxiv-2303-09010.description: Abstract Molecular magnets have received significant attention because of their potential applications in quantum information and quantum computing. A delicate balance of electron correlation, spin-orbit coupling (SOC), ligand field splitting, and other effects produces a persistent magnetic moment within each molecular magnet unit. The discovery and design of molecular magnets with improved functionalities would be greatly aided by accurate computations.

arxiv-2305-17280.title: Improved Instruction Ordering in Recipe-Grounded Conversation
arxiv-2305-17280.creator: Duong Minh Le, Ruohao Guo, Wei Xu, Alan Ritter
arxiv-2305-17280.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the task of instructional dialogue and focus on the cooking domain. Analyzing the generated output of the GPT-J model, we reveal that the primary challenge for a recipe-grounded dialog system is how to provide the instructions in the correct order.

arxiv-2512-10764.title: Hidden No More: Spotlight on tidal disruption events in active galactic nuclei Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2512-10764.creator: Patrik Milán Veres*
arxiv-2512-10764.description: Abstract Tidal disruption events (TDEs) are typically discovered in previously quiescent galaxies. However, earlier studies have revealed a handful of TDEs occurring in pre-existing active galactic nuclei (AGNs). We discuss AT2019aalc, a promising TDE candidate in an AGN, and compare it to similar sources.

arxiv-2602-18805.title: Finite basis problem for varieties of algebraic systems
arxiv-2602-18805.creator: Vesselin Drensky
arxiv-2602-18805.description: Abstract . This is a survey on the finite basis problem for varieties of algebraic systems. Our exposition is in two directions: (i) We give numerous examples of varieties which are not finitely based. (ii) We give examples of important varieties with the property that they and their subvarieties are finitely based.

pmc-11472307.title: Identification of Potent, Broad-Spectrum Coronavirus Main Protease Inhibitors for Pandemic Preparedness
pmc-11472307.creator: David
pmc-11472307.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The COVID-19 pandemic highlights the ongoing risk of zoonotic transmission of coronaviruses to global health. To prepare for future pandemics, it is essential to develop effective antivirals targeting a broad range of coronaviruses. Targeting the essential and clinically validated coronavirus main protease (Mpro), we constructed a structurally diverse Mpro panel by clustering all known coronavirus sequences by Mpro active site sequence similarity.

pmc-12575337.description: BackgroundLung cancer can result in malignant pericardial effusion (MPE), impacting patient prognosis. MPE was managed by intrapericardial infusion of bevacizumab. The first intrapericardial infusion of bevacizumab effectively controlled the MPE for 8 months.

pmc-13271782.title: Determinants of hyperinsulinism severity in children with Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome
pmc-13271782.creator: Andrew M George, Aravind Viswanathan, Jonathan H Sussman, Evan R Hathaway, Abigail Casalnova, Salima Nesbitt, Kara E Boodhansingh, Nicole M Stewart, Heather J McKnight, Katherine Lord, Diva D De León, Charles A Stanley, N Scott Adzick, Arupa Ganguly, Jennifer M Kalish

pmc-13287295.description: Abstractβ-Glucosidases (EC 3.2.1.21) are essential enzymes involved in biomass degradation and metabolic regulation, but the physiological roles of intracellular β-glucosidases in filamentous fungi remain incompletely understood. In this study, we characterized CbgA (AN10124) and CbgB (AN10375), two intracellular glycoside hydrolase family 1 β-glucosidases, in Aspergillus nidulans. Gene deletion and biochemical analyses demonstrated that CbgA is the predominant intracellular β-glucosidase.

pmc-13593206.creator: Marcello Di Nisio, Tzu-Fei Wang
pmc-13593206.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Graphical Abstract Graphical AbstractFor image description, please refer to the figure legend and surrounding text. Introduction

The management of cancer-associated thrombosis (CAT) has changed profoundly over the past decade. Randomized trials have established direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) as effective alternatives to low-molecular-weight heparin, while improving cancer survival has transformed venous thromboembolism (VTE) from an acute complication into a disease requiring chronic management for many patients with cancer.

pmc-13652679.title: 脑脊液宏基因组学第二代测序在新生儿颅内感染诊断中的价值
pmc-13652679.creator: Lingchen LI, Lizhong DU, 方 余, 丽娜 刘
pmc-13652679.description: 目的探讨脑脊液宏基因组学第二代测序（mNGS）在新生儿颅内感染中的诊断性能及对临床决策的影响。方法采用回顾性观察性研究设计，纳入2020—2025年浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院收治的疑似颅内感染且进行脑脊液mNGS的新生儿。计算mNGS的敏感度及其与脑脊液培养-定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）检测结果的一致性。基于预设标准评价其临床影响，将患儿标本分为有影响组和无影响组，探讨mNGS对临床决策产生积极影响的独立因素。结果61例疑诊颅内感染新生儿中48例确诊颅内感染，明确病原体者18例，其中9例仅由mNGS检出，占病原学诊断的50%。mNGS检出敏感度为31.3%（95%CI：18.7%~46.3%），高于脑脊液培养-qPCR检测的18.8%（95%CI：8.9%~32.6%），但差异无统计学意义（P=0.15）。mNGS与脑脊液培养-qPCR检测的阳性一致率为66.7%（95%CI：29.9%~92.5%），阴性一致率为76.9%（95%CI：60.7%~88.9%）。mNGS对23例患儿的临床决策产生了积极影响，包括12例阳性结果指导病原学诊断和治疗调整，和11例阴性结果指导抗感染降级或停止。多因素分析显示mNGS阳性是其产生积极影响的独立因素（OR=22.127，P<0.01）。结论脑脊液mNGS可在新生儿颅内感染的病原学诊断和临床决策上提供积极支持。Keywords: 颅内感染, 新生儿, 诊断, 脑脊液, 宏基因组学第二代测序, 回顾性研究 新生儿颅内感染是一种进展快、破坏性强的疾病，可导致严重的神经系统后遗症，患儿病死率高［1］。快速并准确地找到病原体有助于早期诊断和选择有效的抗感染药物，但新生儿颅内感染病原学诊断面临脑脊液标本量少、培养周期长、阳性率低、高质量循证检测手段有限等困境［1-3］。mNGS作为一种无偏倚测序核酸检测方法，具有敏感度高、检测快、检测范围广等优势，在病原学检测方面展现出较大潜力［4-6］。除病原学检测外，mNGS还可对耐药基因进行分析，为抗感染药物的选择提供依据。然而，由于mNGS费用高昂、临床诊断准确率不明确以及改善临床诊疗证据不充分［4-5］，mNGS尚未在临床实践中常规应用，在新生儿颅内感染中的研究报道更为有限。本研究回顾分析浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院收治的疑似颅内感染并进行脑脊液mNGS的新生儿资料，评估脑脊液mNGS在新生儿颅内感染诊断中的价值。 对象与方法 研究对象 本研究为回顾性观察性研究。纳入2020年1月1日至2025年10月1日由浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院新生儿科、新生儿重症监护室收治的疑似颅内感染且进行脑脊液mNGS的新生儿。疑似颅内感染标准参考《新生儿败血症诊断与治疗专家共识（2024）》［7］，满足下列任意一项：①具有一项及以上非特异性临床表现（体温异常、呼吸增快或暂停、灌注不良、喂养不耐受），及两项及以上血液非特异性感染指标（白细胞计数、血小板计数、C反应蛋白、降钙素原）异常；②具有一项及以上神经系统异常症状或体征（精神反应差或激惹，抽搐或双眼凝视，前囟饱满或颈强直，肌张力异常）。
